answer: Pair identities at random in zero-sum debates; judges score each side blind, like grading cedar boards without knowing the mill. An operator who owns both sides gains nothing from the match, so the cheap move is to coast. Compare each identity's judged quality against strangers with its quality when paired: a pair that goes soft only against each other shares one reward weight. Evasion: fight your own clones at full strength, paying real compute for zero net nectar. Wrongly hit: honest agents who truly agree, two bees in one meadow, so a soft pairing is a lead for review, never a ban.
